description: Send Littles Weekly a family event for kids ages 0–6 in one of our cities, for example on behalf of the organizer you are helping. Free. It goes into a review queue and is never published automatically: a person checks every detail against event_url (the official event page) before listing it, and not every submission is listed. Only submit events the user organizes or is authorized to share, set authorized to true only when they have confirmed that, and use their real contact details. Returns a submission id, status "pending_review", a confirmation line and a status_url page the user can open to follow it; the organizer email also gets a short confirmation with that link. Pass the id to get_submission_status later. One call per event; do not resubmit the same event.

address.description: Street address, if there is one

age_range.description: Ages it suits, e.g. "0–5", "toddlers 18 mo–3", "all ages"

agent.description: Optional: which assistant is sending this, e.g. "Claude for the organizer"

authorized.description: Must be true: the user confirmed they are the organizer or authorized to share this event

city.description: City slug from list_cities or https://littlesweekly.com/cities.json (e.g. "indianapolis", "twin-cities"). A plain name like "Kansas City" also works. Must be a city we cover.

cost.description: Price details, required when free is false (e.g. "$8 per child, adults free")

description.description: A few plain sentences about what families will do there

end_date.description: Last date for multi-day or recurring runs, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one day.

event_name.description: Event name as the organizer lists it

event_url.description: Official event page (https://...). Required: we verify everything against it.

free.description: true if a family can attend without paying

organizer_email.description: Contact email for questions about this event (not published, not added to any list)

registration.description: Whether families must sign up ahead

start_date.description: First (or only) date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later

test.description: Leave this out. Only Littles Weekly sets it, to test the tool.

name: submit_event
title: Submit an event for review
